problem_statement.observed_failure: Private-repository GitHub-hosted Actions quota exhaustion caused ubuntu-latest jobs to fail before runner execution. A hosted reconciliation validation is currently required before the Lambda reconciliation controller will hydrate new project routes, so quota exhaustion indirectly blocked otherwise-free self-hosted research execution.
root_causes: Routine validation and reconciliation still depend on GitHub-hosted ubuntu-latest.
High automation/PR churn multiplies short hosted jobs; per-job billing granularity makes many short jobs expensive in included-minute terms.
The reconciliation controller treats a successful trusted reconciliation workflow run as an authority prerequisite.
The existing project JIT controller admits only owner-commanded issue_comment PR-head jobs, so ordinary pull_request/push workflows cannot safely be moved by changing runs-on alone.

invariants: Scientific and execution authority does not widen because hosted capacity is unavailable.
Dynamic runners never self-authorize the policy needed to create themselves.
Project workload runners remain ephemeral/JIT and fail closed on attestation mismatch.
Control workloads receive no GPU device access.
Control workloads cannot access operator home, Docker sockets, sibling project roots, provisioner state, reconciler state, or research trusted caches.
Project-specific Unix identities and filesystem isolation remain even if GitHub-side runner registration is centralized at organization scope.
Fork pull requests cannot execute privileged self-hosted workloads.
Repository labels, runner labels, and organization membership are routing metadata, not policy authority.
Concurrency is bounded; demand above capacity queues rather than scaling without an explicit policy change.

self_hosted_substrate.controller: official GitHub actions/scaleset client in custom Go controller

current_state.bootstrap_dependency: lambda_ci_reconcile_controller.py selects a successful trusted lambda-ci-project-reconcile.yml run on main (or policy-equivalent ancestor) before submitting reviewed policy to the root reconciliation socket.

layers.purpose: Non-circular, minimal authority needed to validate/recover control-plane policy.
layers.steady_state: Prefer organization runner group restricted to workspace-control and exact trusted bootstrap/reconciliation workflow(s); initially retain hosted workflow or separately installed stable bootstrap runner until the org gate is proven.

layers.purpose: Routine workspace-control validation and bounded control CI.
layers.steady_state: Ephemeral/JIT Lambda runner, project identity workspace-control, max concurrency 1 initially.

layers.purpose: Project CPU/GPU validation and scientific/model workloads.
layers.steady_state: Existing project-scoped research-engine/PADataset identities and JIT runners, optionally registered through organization runner groups later.

runner_groups.name: control-bootstrap
runner_groups.workflow_restriction: exact trusted bootstrap/reconciliation workflows on default branch
runner_groups.runner_model: stable minimal runner or independently provisioned bootstrap scale set

runner_groups.name: padataset
runner_groups.public_repository_access: must be false before enabling organization self-hosted access; public-repo execution requires a separate explicit threat-model decision

github_organization_end_state.credential_target: GitHub App with least-privilege organization self-hosted-runner and required repository read permissions; avoid broad personal PAT as steady-state control credential.
github_organization_end_state.reason: Organization scope centralizes GitHub-side runner inventory/policy while runner groups preserve repo/workflow-level authorization; operating-system execution identities remain project-specific.

phased_plan.objective: Unblock currently valid work without changing authority.
actions: Temporarily restore free/paid hosted capacity; user-selected emergency path is temporary repository public visibility.
Rerun authoritative failed reconciliation 40243005403 and require an actual executed PASS.
Verify lambda-research-engine route hydration.
Allow queued exact-provenance CPU validation to execute and require PASS before exactly one scientific trigger.
Do not treat temporary visibility as the long-term runner security model.
phased_plan.rollback: Return repositories to private immediately if unexpected public-runner/self-hosted interaction or secret exposure is observed.

phased_plan.objective: Create a self-hosted control lane without touching the bootstrap authority.
actions: Add workspace-control project manifest as MIGRATION_CANDIDATE_NOT_INSTALLED.
Use an owner-only issue_comment pilot route so the existing admission-v2 contract can attest exact PR head/workflow identity without widening the controller yet.
Create a dedicated workspace-control validation workflow whose job display claim follows wc-admission-v1.
Keep live reconciliation validation on the existing bootstrap path during this pilot.
Validate filesystem isolation, no-GPU access, resource cap, cleanup, and deterministic receipt behavior.
phased_plan.rollback: Remove/disable the NOT_INSTALLED or pilot route; existing hosted reconciliation remains authoritative.

phased_plan.objective: Make routine PR/push CI self-hosted without manual slash commands.
actions: Add explicit control-small execution profile with approximately 200% CPU, 4-8G MemoryMax, no GPU, short RuntimeMaxSec, max concurrency 1.
Extend attestation schema/controller to safely support pull_request for candidate validation and trusted push/workflow_dispatch for default-branch reconciliation.
Freeze distinct authority rules for candidate validation vs default-branch bootstrap/reconciliation.
Migrate Workspace Control Validation and appropriate research-engine ordinary CI only after new event admission passes adversarial tests.
phased_plan.rollback: Retain previous issue_comment JIT route and hosted/bootstrap fallback until automatic-event admission is accepted.

phased_plan.objective: Centralize GitHub-side runner administration without collapsing OS/project isolation.
actions: Create GitHub organization and transfer repositories in a separately gated change.
Create runner groups with selected-repository and selected-workflow restrictions.
Re-register or migrate scale sets/controllers explicitly; do not assume transfer preserves runner registration.
Move controller authentication to a least-privilege GitHub App.
Update owner-qualified repository references, remote URLs, manifests, attestations, and allowlists.
Prove bootstrap recovery, project isolation, and rollback before disabling old registration paths.
phased_plan.rollback: Repository transfer/runner migration is staged with old credentials/registration recoverable until acceptance; never delete the last known-good bootstrap path before org gates pass.

phased_plan.objective: Private-repository steady state with negligible hosted-runner dependence.
actions: Inventory every runs-on: ubuntu-latest.
Move routine jobs to bounded self-hosted groups.
Retain only an explicitly documented emergency/break-glass hosted workflow if desired.
Set billing budget/alerts to detect accidental hosted usage.
Measure queue depth, CPU/RAM pressure, and research-job interference.
phased_plan.rollback: Emergency hosted workflow remains available subject to budget or temporary public fallback.

resource_model.implication: Workflow/event volume does not cause exponential simultaneous Lambda compute. Qualifying jobs queue behind a bounded lane.
resource_model.research_priority: Control lane must remain CPU-only and bounded so GPU/model work retains priority. Heavy dependency installs or full integration tests may queue but cannot consume GPUs.
resource_model.scale_policy: Any increase above one concurrent control runner requires separate measured queue-pressure and host-resource evidence.

immediate: Every review target is represented by exact Git commit/blob identities in a durable task capsule and PR.
Request GitHub-native review directly on the PR so later reviewers can consume comments without user copy/paste.
Where available, request GitHub Copilot code review automatically for design/code PRs as an additional reviewer, using repository/path review instructions.
A future ChatGPT reviewer starts from task ID and GitHub state; the user should not ferry review text.
review_automation.limitation: This chat cannot autonomously spawn a separate ChatGPT conversation. Copilot code review is useful for code/design review but does not automatically satisfy scientific independence requirements unless the governing task explicitly accepts that reviewer class.
future: Optional review-broker service/GitHub App that creates review jobs against exact blobs and persists signed dispositions; evaluate separately for model cost, credentials, and independence semantics.

required_preimplementation_review: Confirm workspace-control pilot cannot access sibling project roots/control-plane secrets/GPU devices.
Confirm public-repository emergency state is not treated as steady-state security.
Confirm max concurrency and resource ceilings prevent control jobs from starving research workloads.
Confirm automatic-event admission is deferred until separately designed/tested.
Confirm organization migration is staged and reversible.
Confirm review automation cannot self-approve authority-sensitive changes.
first_implementation_authority_if_review: Only P1 design scaffolding and a NOT_INSTALLED workspace-control pilot may proceed after NO_BLOCKING_FINDING. P2/P3 each require their own exact review before live activation.
non_goals: Changing Local EXTRACT science or benchmark authority
Running arbitrary public pull-request code on Lambda
Collapsing all project workloads into a single shared Unix identity
Performing the organization transfer before the local control-pilot gates are satisfied
